questions.text: A new kid is sitting alone at lunch. You…

options.t: Wave them over to my table
Feel bad, but don't do anything

questions.text: I overthink things I said or did, sometimes days later.
After a long day around people, you feel…

options.t: Fine. It could go either way.
Drained. I need to be alone.

questions.text: Doing the bare minimum is honestly fine with me.
Someone in class says something you strongly disagree with. You…

options.t: Ask why they think that and look for common ground
Say my view once, then let it go
Probably end up seeing their side

questions.text: After hanging out for a while, I need alone time to recharge.
You have a big test tomorrow, and you feel unprepared. You…

options.t: Make a plan and grind through it
Text a friend to study together or vent
Play games or scroll so I don't have to think about it
Tell myself it's one test and do what I can

questions.text: I push myself to be really good at the things I care about.
It's Friday night and you have no plans. What sounds ideal?

options.t: A big party or a big group hangout
One person I'm really close with
Home alone with my own stuff

questions.text: Being around a lot of people gives me energy.
You walk into a room full of people you don't know. You…

options.t: Find one person and stick with them
Wait for someone to talk to me
Find a corner and my phone

questions.text: I like my routines and don't feel a need to switch things up.
A sibling (or someone you live with) keeps taking your stuff. You…

options.t: Set a rule and enforce it
Sit down and make a deal that works for both of us
Let them borrow some things but not others
Let it slide. It's not worth the fight.
Hide my stuff so it never comes up

questions.text: Other people's drama doesn't really affect me.
When you get criticized (a harsh grade comment, a coach yelling), you…

options.t: Feel it sting and think about it a lot

questions.text: I don't really care what people think of me.
Which compliment would hit hardest?

options.t: "You're the most fun to be around."

questions.text: I go down rabbit holes learning random stuff just because it's interesting.
When you're really stressed, people would notice that you…

options.t: Want to be around people more

questions.text: I'll go along with what the group wants to keep the peace.
The group chat is full of an inside joke you don't get. You…

options.t: I don't care. I scroll past.

questions.text: It's easy for me to open up to people I trust.
You find out a friend has been talking behind your back. You…

options.t: Feel crushed and wonder what's wrong with me
Calmly ask them about it to hear their side
Talk it over with my other friends

questions.text: I like trying foods, music, or places I've never tried before.
Picking a game, show, or thing to buy, you…

options.t: Read reviews and compare a bunch of options
Grab the first one that seems decent

questions.text: Small things annoy me more than they probably should.
You're told you can't do something, with no reason given. You…

options.t: Ask why until I get a real answer
Accept it. There's probably a reason.

questions.text: I put things off until the last possible minute.
You have a big decision to make (which class, team, or club). You…

options.t: Make a pros and cons list
Put it off as long as I can

questions.text: I zone out into daydreams and imaginary scenarios a lot.
You're stuck between two choices that both seem fine. You…

options.t: Notice which one I secretly hoped the coin would land on
Keep researching until one clearly wins
Wait and let it sort itself out

questions.text: In a group, I usually end up being the one who takes charge.
In a friend group, you'd most want to be…

options.t: The one who makes the calls
The one with the creative ideas
The one who keeps everyone happy
The reliable one everyone counts on

questions.text: When a friend is upset, I feel it too.
Which of these would bother you the most?

options.t: Being told exactly how to do everything
Being bored with nothing going on

questions.text: Deep "what's the point of it all" questions bore me.
A plan you were really excited about gets ruined. You…

options.t: Immediately start working on plan B
Feel bummed for a while, then move on
Shrug it off. There will be other chances.

questions.text: I feel awkward when people are watching me do something.
Someone you just met wants to become close friends, fast. You…

options.t: Cool, but I take a while to really open up
It feels weird. I'd back off.
Love it, but I'd worry they'll get bored of me

questions.text: I'm drawn to things that are loud, fast, or a little intense.
Your friend cancels plans last minute. You…

options.t: Feel relieved. Chill night for me.
Wonder if they're mad at me
Text someone else and make new plans
Tell them it's annoying when they do that

questions.text: I sometimes worry my friends like each other more than they like me.
A friend asks your honest opinion on something they made, and it's not great. You…

options.t: Point out the good parts and gently suggest fixes

questions.text: I lose track of my stuff (charger, keys, homework) pretty often.
You have way too much to do. You…

options.t: Make a list and knock things out one by one
Freeze up and do nothing for a while
Ask for help or an extension
Do the fun or easy stuff first

questions.text: When someone gets really close to me, part of me wants to back off.
Would you rather have…
I get suspicious when people are nice to me for no reason.
After you choose something, you…

options.t: Keep wondering if the other option was better
Sometimes wonder, but I'm mostly fine

questions.text: I need people to show they care, or I start to doubt it.
What helps most after a bad day?

options.t: Writing, drawing, or making something about it

questions.text: I don't worry much. Things usually work out.
Pick the life that sounds best at 30:

options.t: Doing my own thing, my own way, no boss
Respected and at the top of my field
Stable and comfy, with people I love close by

questions.text: If someone takes forever to text back, I wonder if I did something wrong.
You win $10,000. First move?

options.t: Save or invest most of it
Buy the stuff I've wanted forever
Give a real chunk to family or a cause

questions.text: I'd rather deal with what's real than imagine what could be.
A friend is mad at you, and you think they're the one who's wrong. You…

options.t: Hear them out fully, then explain my side and work it out
Meet them halfway. We were both a little wrong.
Give it space and wait for it to blow over

questions.text: I'd rather handle things myself than depend on other people.
Pick a superpower:
My room, files, or notes have some kind of system.
When you're figuring out what you think about something, you…

options.t: Think it through on my own first

questions.text: I'll argue a point just to win, even when it doesn't really matter.
How fast do you usually decide stuff?

options.t: Instantly. I go with the impulse.
Pretty fast, once I've thought for a second
Slow. I need all the info first.
It depends on what everyone else is doing

questions.text: When I say I'll do something, I actually do it.
A teacher makes a mistake on your grade, in your favor. You…

options.t: It depends how big the mistake is
Keep quiet. Their mistake, not mine.

questions.text: It takes a lot to make me mad.
In the group chat, you're…

options.t: Only active when it's something I care about

questions.text: I'd rather let someone else do the talking.
Someone dares you to do something scary but safe (a giant rollercoaster, singing on stage). You…

options.t: Do it after some hyping up

questions.text: I'd pick a calm night over a wild one.
In a group project, someone isn't doing their part. You…

options.t: Talk to them privately, figure out what's up, and fix it together
Suggest re-splitting the work so it's fair
Do their part myself so it gets done
Say nothing and hope it works out

questions.text: I assume people mean well until they show me otherwise.
You get a free day with zero obligations. You…

options.t: Hang out with friends all day
Get ahead on stuff I need to do

questions.text: Something embarrassing happens in front of everyone. You…

options.t: Replay it in my head for days
Tell my friends about it so it's less weird
Avoid those people for a while

questions.text: You and a friend want to do completely different things on Saturday. You…

options.t: Push for my plan. It's the better one.
Find something we're both actually excited about
Split it: half the day mine, half theirs
Just go with their plan. It's not a big deal.
Sort of dodge it and see if the plans fall through

questions.text: Rules are…

options.t: Guidelines. I follow the good ones and question the dumb ones.
Honestly, kind of made to be broken
Only fair if they apply to everyone equally

questions.text: What would you most want to be known for?

options.t: Always being there for my people

O.name: Openness
O.desc: Imagination, curiosity, love of new experiences

N.name: Emotional sensitivity
N.desc: How strongly stress, worry and frustration hit

att_anxiety.name: Attachment anxiety
att_anxiety.desc: Fear of being left out, needing reassurance

att_avoidance.name: Attachment avoidance
att_avoidance.desc: Discomfort with closeness and depending on others

cf_competing.name: Competing
cf_competing.desc: Assert your side, aim to win

cf_collaborating.name: Collaborating
cf_collaborating.desc: Work it out so both sides win

cf_accommodating.name: Accommodating
cf_accommodating.desc: Give way to keep the peace

v_self_direction.name: Self-direction
v_self_direction.desc: Freedom, originality, doing it your way

v_achievement.name: Achievement
v_achievement.desc: Being great at things, recognition for skill

v_benevolence.name: Benevolence
v_benevolence.desc: Caring for the people close to you

cope_distract.name: Distract
cope_distract.desc: Shift attention away (games, shows, staying busy)

cope_express.name: Express
cope_express.desc: Let the feeling out (venting, making things, snapping)
